subject: Urgent: Hold on Payouts — VAT Treatment Dispute and Recovery Path for Stellar Dynamics
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <finance@stellardynamics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:14:00-05:00
Subject: Urgent: Hold on Payouts — VAT Treatment Dispute and Recovery Path for Stellar Dynamics

Hi Elena,

Following up on several earlier threads — invoice INV-8891 (issued 2026-10-07) remains outstanding at €142,350 and is now 42 days overdue. We attached the invoice and the signed SOW for reference (INV-8891-Redwood.pdf, SOW-Q3-Redwood-Stellar.pdf).

You previously mentioned Stellar is withholding the VAT portion pending validation of entity routing and reverse-charge evidence. We absolutely want to make this straightforward. To unblock the payment we need one of the following by close of business on 2026-11-24:

- A valid EU VAT registration number for the paying entity plus a signed reverse-charge declaration OR
- A remittance plan confirming staged payment with dates and amounts, signed by an authorized finance contact.

If neither is available, please confirm whether Stellar can remit the net amount today (70% of total) with the balance to follow within 21 days once documentation is provided. If you prefer a call, happy to jump on one this week.

Next steps from our side if we don’t hear back: we will escalate to our credit committee and prepare a staged remit agreement to protect both parties. We prefer to avoid service interruptions; however, prolonged non-payment forces us to consider limited feature holds for non-production integrations.

Appreciate your quick response.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: INV-8891-Redwood.pdf (invoice, 1pg), SOW-Q3-Redwood-Stellar.pdf (signed SOW, 3pg)

From: Elena Ruiz <finance@stellardynamics.com>

Date: 2026-11-19T11:03:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Hold on Payouts — VAT Treatment Dispute and Recovery Path for Stellar Dynamics

Jonas,

Thanks for the note. We are not refusing payment; we are clarifying tax treatment to remain compliant with local authorities. Our treasury team is withholding the VAT element until we receive evidence that Redwood is correctly VAT-registered for cross-border services.

What we can provide now:
- Withholding confirmation (attached) showing net payment calculation for internal audit.
- We can remit 70% of the invoice (net) by 2026-11-23, but the VAT portion will be held until we receive a valid VAT registration and reverse-charge declaration from Redwood.

Please send: your VAT registration certificate and a short statement confirming which legal entity on the SOW is the billed party. Without this we risk local tax exposure. I’ve attached our internal remit note for transparency (stellardynamics_vat_evidence.pdf).

Regards,
Elena Ruiz
CFO (acting), Stellar Dynamics
finance@stellardynamics.com

Attachment: stellardynamics_withhold_notice.pdf (remittance instruction, 1pg)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Urgent: Hold on Payouts — VAT Treatment Dispute and Recovery Path for Stellar Dynamics

Elena,

Thanks for the transparency and for the 70% offer. We can accept a staged remit provided the following are agreed in writing today:

1) Stellar remits 70% of the invoiced amount (net) by 2026-11-23 to the wire details on the invoice.
2) Stellar signs a short staged remit agreement confirming the remaining 30% will be paid within 21 days of Redwood providing VAT evidence (or earlier if resolved). Draft attached: proposed-staged-remit-agreement.pdf.
3) Redwood will provide VAT registration (EU VAT ID: GB999888777) and a reverse-charge statement for the billed entity (Redwood Inference Ltd) by 2026-11-22 COB.

Marcus and Laura: please review the proposed staged remit document and flag any legal/credit concerns. Kimberly, looping you for visibility and exec alignment in case this needs credit committee approval.

If we get confirmation on 1-3 today I will have finance mark the account as "staged remit" and remove any immediate service restriction actions. Otherwise, we will need to escalate via the credit committee on Monday.

Jonas

Attachment: proposed-staged-remit-agreement.pdf (1pg)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Team,

Thanks for the quick triage. High level decision: we are comfortable approving a staged remit (70/30) for Stellar Dynamics provided legal signs off and Treasury confirms the remittance mechanics. Please take these actions now:

- Laura: confirm the staged remit wording is enforceable and includes an explicit payment schedule and remedy if the second tranche is delayed.
- Marcus: confirm we can provide the VAT registration PDF (attached to this thread) and a one-line reverse-charge statement from our billing team. If any of the information is inconsistent with the SOW entity, escalate to me before sending.
- Jonas: secure the signed stage-remit document from Stellar (signature or email confirmation) and upload the document to the HubSpot deal (link below).

If any party refuses staged remit we prepare a credit committee memo for Monday with the recommendation to pause onboarding for new integrations while maintaining prod read-only access. This is a measured escalation; we want to protect cash without damaging the relationship.

I will be available for a short call with Stellar finance on 2026-11-23 at 14:00 UTC if needed.

Kimberly Park
VP, Revenue Operations
kimberly.park@redwood.com
